description: case2_ev_v5: immutable Base demand with optional paid service pools; baseline adequacy retained.

parameter_status.thermal_service: Existing V5 thermal envelopes and nonnegative periodic service inventories; increase plus reduction shares paid contracted power. No comfort debt or literal indoor-temperature state is introduced.
parameter_status.ev_v1g: The 15% reference pool is an eligibility ceiling. Endogenous proportional enrollment leaves all nonparticipants at immutable baseline demand.
parameter_status.ev_v2g: The bidirectional subset has separate charging and service inventory; its share is nested in enrolled V1G and limited by 10%/15%. No observed vehicle SOC or plug sessions are claimed.
parameter_status.capacity_value: No flexible firm capacity credit. Retain the exact Base planning adequacy basis until a separately validated event-delivery contract exists.
parameter_status.price_basis: All monetary parameters are expressed in 2025 constant CNY. Retail energy tariffs and incentive transfers are excluded from social system cost; real control, infrastructure, inconvenience and degradation costs are included.
parameter_status.legacy_scalar_alignment: The inherited generic shift-throughput and degradation scalars are aligned to the V5 central V1G relocation and V2G degradation values for manifest readability; the optimization uses the service-specific cost input file.
